newsitem.title: USA: Lilly sees Q2 EPS boosted by Dow Elanco.
newsitem.headline: Lilly sees Q2 EPS boosted by Dow Elanco.

text.p: Eli Lilly and Co said it expects earnings per share for the second quarter to be boosted by a one-time gain in the $0.56-to-$0.62 range as a result of the sale of its 40-percent stake in Dow Elanco to Dow Chemical Co.
Lilly said it expects to realize a $310 million to $340 million one-time, after-tax gain on the $900-million sale of its interest in the agricultural chemicals joint venture.
Lilly said Thursday it agreed to sell DowElanco for about $1.2 billion, a purchase price that also includes undistributed earnings of about $300 million.
Lilly said it would like to close the transaction by the end of the second quarter. The company said it does not expect anti-trust obstacles to the transaction.
Lilly said it will use most of the proceeds from the sale to reduce debt. The company's total debt at the end of first quarter was $3.8 billion.
